source: This is why two kernels with the same mathematical operation count can run at very different speeds. One mapping may continually fetch data from device memory. Another may reorganize the work so that each fetched tile participates in many operations before it is replaced.
zh: 这就是为什么具有相同数学运算次数的两个内核可以以非常不同的速度运行。一种映射可以连续地从设备存储器获取数据。另一种可能会重新组织工作，以便每个获取的图块在被替换之前参与许多操作。
